sections.title: Case loading decision
sections.what: Defines the three possible outcomes and loads a case, returning ready, not found, or an error message.
sections.why: Likely reason: lets pages handle all three outcomes the same way. Reason not stated in the code.
sections.watch_out: Because the catch hides every error, a broken service will look like a generic load failure.

summary: Loads one case and reports whether it is ready, not found, or failed, so pages can show the right screen.
purpose: Gives case pages one place to decide what to show when a case is loaded.
why: Likely reason: keeps the loading decision in one place. Reason not stated in the code.
how: Asks the case service for the case in the chosen language. If a case comes back it reports ready with the details. If nothing comes back it reports not found. If loading throws any error it reports an error with a friendly message.
inputs: A case ID, an optional case service, and a language, defaulting to English.
outputs: One of three results: ready with case details, not found, or error with a message.
risks: Every error is turned into the same friendly message, so a real bug in the service is hidden from the developer.
debug: If a case shows an error, check the case service directly for that case ID. Temporarily log the caught error to see the real cause.
